dedupe_keys.name: a logit mixture model estimating the heterogeneous mode choice preferences of shippers based on aggregate data

description: Nicolet, Adrien and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. The implemented model estimates a population distribution of shipper cost sensitivity directly from aggregate transport data. Coverage is a Rhine-Alpine corridor application, comparing predictions and preference heterogeneity with a Weighted Logit baseline. The source reports similar predictive power and a more detailed representation of heterogeneous preferences. A separately depositedCSV input collection is linked. These estimates are not direct observations of confidential individual shipments, and choice probabilities depend on the aggregate data and model assumptions. Zenodo supplies the descriptive publication with open access under cc-by-4.0. The publication does not establish public access to an implementation or its separate licence. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations. The model supports estimation of heterogeneous freight-mode preferences.
